title: 第8章 意外发现第9章 妖袭
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 次日一早。
沈长青是被李沐颜叫醒的。
看着这有些凌乱的床，他本以为自己踏上修行之道后，会一心向道，但事实证明，佳人在侧，他根本没有拒绝的理由。
乃至于现在，看着李沐颜那端坐在梳妆台前忙碌的身影，他都有些食髓知味了。
好在，这并非什么坏事。
【功法：养气术（圆满），周天行气法（未入门：4500）】
看着自己面板上的信息，沈长青不禁微微勾起了嘴角：“没想到，这不仅没有影响我的修行，反而还令我有了意想不到的收获。”
昨夜缠绵之时，他就发现了自己体内的周天行气法竟自发的运转了起来。
本以为只是个意外，但谁能想到，今早起来，周天行气法的经验值竟然增加了一点！
“难道，这就是双……修？”
沈长青想到了一种可能，他当即问道：“对了，颜儿，你修炼的修行法是什么？”
几次的肌肤之亲后，两人之间的关系虽然还谈不上亲密，但却也慢慢变得熟络了起来。
李沐颜有些奇怪，为何沈长青会突然问这个问题，但她还是答道：“周天行气法。”
“你的修行法也是周天行气法？！”
沈长青一愣，心中愈发觉得自己的猜测是正确的。
“东漓学宫内院有好几座山的修行法都是周天行气法呢，而且别忘了，这太虚剑观本来也是东漓学宫的一部分。”
李沐颜今天穿了一身月白纱裙，束带系紧的纤细腰身上挂着一串银色的小铃铛，她身姿轻盈，气质空灵，起身带着悦耳的铃声推门走出了房间，“外城区很危险，你快起床，等会儿我送你过去。”
沈长青应了一声，脑子里却在想事情，“看来是因为我们修炼了同一种修行法，并且她的修为比我高很多所以才会出现这种情况。”
换句话说，这里的灵气虽然驳杂不堪，难以修行，但两人在深入交流的时候，他在无形中借用了李沐颜体内的灵力来修炼。
而李沐颜体内的灵力澎湃如海，这一点细微的变化，那种时候她根本都没注意到。
当然，这个提升十分微弱，若非他有面板，否则根本不会注意到。
“具体是不是这样，等晚上回来就知道了。”
沈长青走出房间的时候，正好碰到李沐颜一脸喜意的走了过来。
“长青，你看。”
李沐颜的笑音像铃声一样轻灵、悦耳，她快步来到沈长青面前，晃了晃自己的小手。
仿若柔荑般的手在眼前摊开，洁白无瑕的玉指上，躺着一支半尺长的青色玉瓶。
沈长青面露疑惑，“这是什么？”
李沐颜答道：“聚气丹，此丹可以大幅提升修行效率，让你更快入门。”
她说着，将玉瓶塞进了沈长青的手中，“但要注意，每十天才能吞服一枚，不然有伤及根基的风险。”
沈长青打开一看，发现里面静静的躺着三枚拇指指甲大小的青色丹药。
浓郁的药香扑鼻而来，霎时间，他感觉全身的经脉都像是兴奋了起来。
好东西。
沈长青眼睛一亮，问道：“这丹药价值不菲吧？”
“十枚灵石一枚。”
李沐颜道：“这是我爹娘给你的，你收着就行。”
“三十枚灵石！”
三十枚灵石，看起来不多，但放在沈家，可以买走他的人生大事，放在负债累累的李家，也可能是压死骆驼的最后一根稻草。
沈长青忽然感觉手中丹药的分量变重了很多，“我听说李家现在情况不是很好，有没有什么我能帮上忙的地方？”
“不用。”
李沐颜摇头道：“别看这李府这么空荡，但其实我李家的生意人手还是充足的，如今的李家，缺的不是人，而是能坐镇家族的强者，所以，你好好修炼就行。”
李沐颜忽的轻笑一声，唤出飞剑，带着沈长青冲天而起。
content_en:
Early the next morning.
Shen Changqing was woken up by Li Muyan.
Looking at the somewhat messy bed, he thought that after embarking on the path of spiritual practice, he would devote himself to the Tao, but it turned out that with the beautiful woman by his side, he had no reason to refuse.
Even now, looking at Li Muyan's busy figure sitting in front of the dressing table, he felt a little confused.
Fortunately, this is not a bad thing.
[Exercises: Nourishing Qi (Perfection), Circular Qi Movement (Uninitiated: 4500)]
Looking at the information on his panel, Shen Changqing couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth slightly: "Unexpectedly, not only did this not affect my practice, but it also gave me unexpected gains."
When he was lingering last night, he discovered that the Zhoutian Qi Movement in his body started to move spontaneously.
I thought it was just an accident, but who would have thought that when I woke up this morning, the experience value of Zhoutian Qi Movement actually increased a little!
"Could this be dual...cultivation?"
Shen Changqing thought of a possibility, and he immediately asked: "By the way, Yan'er, what is your practice method?"
After several skin-to-skin kisses, although the relationship between the two was not yet intimate, they gradually became more familiar with each other.
Li Muyan was a little surprised as to why Shen Changqing suddenly asked this question, but she still answered: "Zhou Tian Qi Movement Technique."
"Your practice method is also the Zhoutian Qi method?!"
Shen Changqing was stunned, and felt more and more that his guess was correct.
"There are several mountains in the inner courtyard of Dongli Academy that practice the Zhoutian Qi Method. And don't forget, the Taixu Sword Temple was originally part of Dongli Academy."
Li Muyan wore a moon-white gauze dress today, with a string of small silver bells hanging from her slender waist that was tied tightly. She had a light figure and an ethereal temperament. She stood up and pushed the door open with a pleasant ringing sound and walked out of the room. "The outer city is very dangerous. Get up quickly. I will take you there later."
"Okay."
Shen Changqing responded, but was thinking about something in his mind, "It seems that this situation occurs because we practice the same cultivation method, and her cultivation level is much higher than mine."
In other words, although the spiritual energy here was mixed and difficult to cultivate, when the two had in-depth communication, he invisibly borrowed the spiritual power from Li Muyan's body to practice.
And the spiritual power in Li Muyan's body was surging like the sea. At that time, she didn't even notice this subtle change.
Of course, this improvement is very weak, and if he didn't have a panel, he wouldn't notice it at all.
"Whether this is the case specifically, we will know when we get back in the evening."
When Shen Changqing walked out of the room, he happened to meet Li Muyan walking over with a happy face.
"Evergreen, look."
Li Muyan's smile was as light and sweet as a bell. She quickly came to Shen Changqing and shook her little hand.
The catkin-like hands were spread out in front of his eyes, and on the flawless white jade fingers, there lay a half-foot-long cyan jade bottle.
Shen Changqing looked confused, "What is this?"
Li Muyan replied: "Qi Gathering Pill, this pill can greatly improve the efficiency of practice and allow you to get started faster."
She said, putting the jade bottle into Shen Changqing's hand, "But be careful, you can only swallow one every ten days, otherwise there is a risk of damaging the foundation."
Shen Changqing opened it and found three green elixirs the size of thumbnails lying quietly inside.
The strong medicinal fragrance hit his nostrils, and in an instant, he felt that all the meridians in his body seemed to be excited.
nice one.
Shen Changqing's eyes lit up and he asked, "Isn't this elixir worth a lot of money?"
"Ten spirit stones for one."
Li Muyan said: "My parents gave this to you, just keep it."
"Thirty spirit stones!"
Thirty spiritual stones may not seem like much, but if placed in the Shen family, they could buy him major life events. If placed in the debt-ridden Li family, it might be the straw that broke the camel's back.
Shen Changqing suddenly felt that the weight of the elixir in his hand had become much heavier, "I heard that the Li family is not in a very good situation right now. Is there anything I can do to help?"
"No need."
Li Muyan shook her head and said: "Although the Li Mansion is so empty, in fact, my Li family's business manpower is still sufficient. What the Li family lacks today is not people, but strong men who can take charge of the family, so you just need to practice hard."
Li Muyan suddenly chuckled, summoned the flying sword, and took Shen Changqing into the sky.
